title: Wayback CDX → Markdown output
description: Dataset rows are extracted snapshot Markdown (and optional RAG chunks). Key-value store holds CDX_REPORT and OUTPUT run summary.

results.title: Snapshots / chunks
results.description: Default dataset items. Snapshot rows include: kind, status, originalUrl, archiveUrl, timestamp, title, contentMarkdown, contentHash, wordCount, mimeType, statusCode, digest. Chunk rows include chunkIndex, text, headingPath, tokenEstimate. Views: overview, chunks.

cdxReport.title: CDX report
cdxReport.description: Key-value store record CDX_REPORT (JSON array): one entry per input URL/domain with cdxHits, selected, fetchedOk, fetchedFailed, error.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Key-value store record OUTPUT (JSON): targets, itemsOutput, chunksOutput, cdxHits, fetchErrors, durationSecs.
